summary: Partial review. Controller evidence shows the governance check passed (exit 0). I read the core event path in production code: event-log, event-manager, event-writer, classify-engine, connector-link and its intake-mapping and ack section, delivery, the get_events read (events-read) and read-tools, plus the connector's ingest. In these files I found no defects: the event is written in one transaction (classify, log, state, audit) before the ack; dedup is by unique event_id; delivery re-checks the subscription and client before every retry; the get_events cursor never skips events. I did not read the outbox store, normalize, the push listener, subscriptions, the callback transport, the contracts, the plan or tasks, or any tests. Links in the doorbell.ding path that I left unverified: Ring push to normalized event (identity and timestamps), the outbox durability and resend ordering, the callback transport's address checks, and the comparison against the plan, tasks and iteration-002 tools schema. No findings are established; this is not a clean pass.
